title: Watercolor 421 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in the Park District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Carriage House- Professionally decorated- 5 adult bikes- Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Welcome to 421 Western Lake Drive, a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House that sleeps 12 guests in WaterColor. Enjoy access to all neighborhood amenities, including multiple community pools and the beach club! Natural beauty and activities are around every corner in this resort-style community—whether it’s biking the Timpoochee Trail or kayaking across the tranquil waters of a coastal dune lake. Guests will love relaxing on the spacious and welcoming porches.Luxury and leisure abound inside the inviting Main House. Wainscotted walls and a tongue-and-groove ceiling adorn the first-floor living space, featuring a plush corner sofa, TV, and a table seating 4. On the screened porch, a hanging bed swing and wicker patio furniture, including a table for 4, overlook the lush greenery. Sit and savor the salty breeze, or unwind in the sun at the patio table. There are 2 guest bedrooms—2 with a king bed —and a comfortable bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds on this floor.Upstairs, a stunning cathedral ceiling and plenty of soft seating create an elegant gathering space. The chef of the group will delight in the connected kitchen’s high-end Wolf stovetop and wine cooler. Tucked into a windowed breakfast nook is a round 4-person table, with extra seating for 2 at both the island and bar. Beyond that is a formal dining room with a table for 8—perfect for a meal or game night! On the balcony, find a built-in grill, alfresco table for 4, and cushioned furniture. The primary bedroom has a king bed and a private porch with a swing and a sitting area.The Carriage House offers a private and airy sanctuary with a king bed, private bathroom, queen sleeper sofa, kitchenette, and balcony.A delightful getaway awaits at 421 Western Lake Drive in WaterColor. Exploring the rest of scenic 30A is easy with on-site parking and 5 adult bikes. Beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club and a second access is off Goldenrod Circle past the Watercolor Inn. Book this lovely home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:First Floor:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin BunksSecond Floor:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCarriage House:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
